$comment: Copy to .claude/local.json, which is git-ignored. PATHS AND NAMES ONLY —
never a token value. If you find yourself pasting a secret in here, stop:
the file it lives in is what belongs here, not what is inside it.
Every field is optional. Defaults live in scripts/local/local-config.mjs,
and on a machine where the token sits at ~/devex-cf-token.txt the whole
file can be left out. It exists so the setup is written down rather than
machine: a name for this computer, for your own reference
